title: Unauthorized Access to Zone Definitions
description: Sensitive zone data (e.g., home, school locations) stored in DS2 could be accessed by unauthorized parties if access controls are insufficient.
assumptions: DS2 lacks robust authentication/encryption for stored data.

title: Zone Data Misuse Beyond Geofencing
description: Geofencing Engine (P2) may use zone definitions for purposes beyond location-based alerts (e.g., profiling, third-party sharing).
assumptions: P2 has no strict data usage policies or audit mechanisms.

title: Zone Data Linked to Individuals
description: Zone definitions (e.g., 'home') can be linked to specific family members, enabling identification of individuals' locations.
assumptions: Zone data is associated with user accounts containing personal identifiers.
uncertainty_note: Assumes zone data is tied to identifiable user accounts; may vary if zones are anonymized.

title: Lack of Transparency in Data Access
description: Users may not be informed that their zone data is accessed by the Geofencing Engine for processing.
assumptions: No clear privacy notices or consent mechanisms for data flow DS2->P2.
